label: Response time
intent: The wait for a reply is timed: a round chat bubble with clock hands. Light: the minute hand sweeps one full turn at a steady pace and stops dead on the hour, and the bubble hops as the reply lands, then settles. Strong: the hand winds back first, sweeps round faster and stops dead, and the bubble hops higher and lands with two bounces.

bubble.//: the bubble hops as the reply lands, carrying the clock

minute.rotate.//: a whole turn, then a step from 360 back to the identical 0 so the rest pose is pixel-exact
